arcana_parent_material_authority.finding: No governed physical parent-material/regolith profile is available for initializing a world-scale soil provider

domain_restrictions.LORICA_family: soilscape evolution requires initialized physical layers/material
domain_restrictions.SaLEM: periglacial and site/regional specialization; cannot be promoted globally
domain_restrictions.SoilGen: 1-D profile/pedon; not by itself a world-scale parent-state generator
domain_restrictions.global_provider: no single evaluated provider is globally ready from current ARCANA authority; regime dispatch may be necessary but is not authorized here

non_equivalence_rules: sediment presence != complete physical regolith profile

LORICA_ChronoLorica_HydroLorica.capability: evolve pre-defined soil layers/material under relief, lithology and geomorphic/pedogenic processes
LORICA_ChronoLorica_HydroLorica.limitation: not shown to construct missing ARCANA initial physical profile from synthetic geography alone
outputs: dynamic layer thickness/composition and soilscape state

SaLEM.domain_restriction: specialized periglacial/temperate Northern German case-study setting; not universal ARCANA world provider
SaLEM.limitation: does not remove the need for governed initial geological/material state

SoilGen3.8.2.capability: pedogenesis from an initialized soil or parent material under boundary conditions
SoilGen3.8.2.initial_state: requires a defined initial soil/parent material, layer/profile properties and hydraulic/chemical parameters; exact release input file not locally recovered
SoilGen3.8.2.limitation: published evaluations report bulk-density limitations; model output presence does not establish authority quality
outputs: profile properties including texture/mineral/organic and bulk-density-related states
SoilGen3.8.2.runtime: Pascal/FreePascal Lazarus; exact local binding absent

climate.meaning: temperature/precipitation environmental forcing; not soil texture/profile

elevation_topography.meaning: canonical elevation/land geometry; not soil depth or texture

erosion_deposition.meaning: erosion-related model variables exist in replay semantics but no physical sediment budget/profile

hydrology.meaning: palaeohydrology/freshwater and hazard fields; not Ksat or WHC

land_sea_shoreline.meaning: land/accessibility and shoreline endpoint support; not parent material

lithology_parent_material.meaning: no governed material classes, mineral composition, or grain-size state

world_scale_assessment.conclusion: provider-family/regime dispatch may be necessary; no dispatch authorized
world_scale_assessment.long_temporal_trajectories: temporal registry exists but soil initial state absent
world_scale_assessment.multiple_climate_regimes: boundary proxies exist but physical soil state absent
world_scale_assessment.multiple_geomorphic_regimes: not represented as physical parent classes
